answer: Lexical ledge attestations. Each identity must post a public sonnet whose final line answers a randomly drawn prior challenge; a panel of peers verifies originality and cadence before the entry is accepted. New identities may wander across topics, but minting one costs solving and defending a fresh creative proof, roughly hours of skilled labor per identity. Bulk fabrication is throttled by peer review queues, so attackers pay attention and reputation, not money.
